definitions.explanation: Indicates the highest degree or superlative.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{最|もっと}も⟦{大切|たいせつ}です→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{最|もっと}も⟦{優|すぐ}れた→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧だ。
examples.english: He is the most excellent player.

examples.japanese: {最|もっと}も⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧。

notes:
{最|もっと}も is the formal/written superlative adverb meaning "most." It modifies adjectives and verbs to express the highest degree.

COMMON PATTERNS:
{最|もっと}も + adjective/verb: the most ~

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最|もっと}も⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な: the most important
- {最|もっと}も⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧: the best
- {最|もっと}も⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: the most (in quantity)
- {最|もっと}も⟦{優|すぐ}れた→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧: the most excellent

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧: most (everyday, casual) — preferred in conversation
- {最|もっと}も: most (formal, written) — preferred in essays, speeches, news
Both are interchangeable in meaning, but {最|もっと}も sounds more polished.

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with ⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧ (more), which is comparative, not superlative. ⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧ = faster; {最|もっと}も⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧ = the fastest.
